Text:
One single continuous photograph — no panels, grids, or split frames.

PRIORITY ORDER — when instructions conflict, the lower number wins
1. The uploaded image's composition and geometry.
2. The exact people and vehicle counts given below.
3. The historical transformation for the target year.
4. The specific period details listed.
5. Add nothing that is not asked for — no extra businesses, signs, vehicles,
   people, logos or advertisements.

Use the uploaded photo as the exact base composition. The street in the source
is empty — populate it with the people and vehicles specified below. Remove the
modern businesses, logos, brands, storefront names, banners and advertisements
visible in the source image, and replace them only with the period signage
specified below.

PRESERVE
Keep the uploaded image's composition, camera angle, geometry, buildings,
roads and permanent structures exactly as they are. Do not redraw,
reposition or restyle them. Change only what the sections below ask for.

OUTPUT FORMAT
Create a TRUE 9:16 vertical portrait. Expand the SAME scene naturally above
(sky) and below (street/pavement) as canvas extension — do not stretch or
distort the source geometry.

TRANSFORM TO 1995
Clinton era prosperity. A 1995 main street — the video rental store at its absolute peak, a computer shop newly arrived, chain logos displacing the last hand-painted signs.

CONDITION: busy — customers present, high activity, all pumps in use

PERIOD DETAILS
- pizza and sub shop with a '2 SLICES + SODA $2.99' sign in the window
- BLUE PLATE DINER with 'HOT COFFEE 75¢' in the window
- computer shop with a 'PENTIUM PCs — INTERNET SOFTWARE' banner
- a RadioShack store, red sign board with white lettering
- window signs: 'SUB COMBO $3.99', 'FREE INTERNET TRIAL — 30 DAYS'
- a wall-mounted payphone or payphone booth
- a cluster of coin-operated newspaper boxes on the corner
- a stack of free classified-ad papers in a wire rack
Typography: clean geometric sans-serif, early digital influence.


SIGNAGE RESTRICTION
The only readable text anywhere in the image is:
'2 SLICES + SODA $2.99'
'HOT COFFEE 75¢'
'PENTIUM PCs — INTERNET SOFTWARE'
'SUB COMBO $3.99'
'FREE INTERNET TRIAL — 30 DAYS'
Do not render any other readable words, business names, slogans, advertisements, logos or brand names. Lettering that appears elsewhere must be too small, too distant or too weathered to read as words.

PEOPLE
EXACTLY 10 people TOTAL: 4 near sidewalk (largest, foreground), 4 opposite sidewalk mid-block, 2 distant, far end of block. Grouped in pairs, threes, and singles.
- a shop clerk restocking the newspaper rack
- a man on rollerblades weaving around pedestrians
- an office worker with a pager on his belt
Clothing: men in backwards caps, baggy jeans; women in chokers, slip dresses. Fashion palette: forest green, maroon, mustard yellow. No posing or eye contact. All people stay on sidewalks, at storefronts, or beside parked vehicles — never standing, sitting, or walking in the road or driving lanes.

VEHICLES
EXACTLY 6 period vehicles, all different:
- 1990-1997 Mazda Miata — tiny rounded roadster, pop-up lights — burgundy
- 1993-1998 Jeep Grand Cherokee — early SUV, boxy-rounded — white
- 1995-2004 Toyota Tacoma — compact, rounded — black
- 1991-1995 Dodge Caravan — rounded second-gen minivan — silver
- 1993-1997 Ford Ranger — compact pickup, straight lines — hunter green
- 1990-1994 Chevrolet Lumina — rounded mid-size sedan — teal
Parked with gaps. Where a model is listed with a year range, render the 1995 model year specifically — only styling, trim and features available in 1995, nothing introduced later. No vehicle newer than 1995.
Parked vehicles hug the curb — parallel, each facing its lane's direction; none sideways, diagonal, or against traffic. Keep at least one full driving lane clear each way for through traffic.
PLACEMENT: two parked on the LEFT side; the rest parked on the RIGHT side with gaps. No vehicle in the same spot as any other era.

ENVIRONMENT
- road markings: yellow center line, white edge lines, turn lane arrows
- utilities: overhead power lines standard, cable TV and early phone data lines on poles

TREES
- oak tree at sidewalk left near corner: clearly smaller than in the base image — about 75% of its canopy there, thinner trunk
- maple tree at sidewalk center in front of retail: clearly smaller than in the base image — about 45% of its canopy there, thinner trunk
Tree sizes MUST follow this specification even where they differ from the base image.

PHOTOGRAPHIC STYLE
COLOR photograph — Kodak Gold 200 or Fujifilm Superia 200 look.
Color: neutral to slightly warm tones. Grain: fine grain, cleaner than 1985.
Photorealistic — NOT black-and-white, no HDR.

PRIVACY
Blur all faces and license plates.
SelectedVehicles: 1990-1997 Mazda Miata — tiny rounded roadster, pop-up lights
1993-1998 Jeep Grand Cherokee — early SUV, boxy-rounded
1993-1997 Ford Ranger — compact pickup, straight lines
